# Newspaper Theme

[GitHub Download Link](https://github.com/EvobyteDigitalBiology/st-styled/blob/main/src/st_yled/themes/newspaper/config.toml)

![Newspaper Theme Preview Placeholder](https://evo-byte.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/newspaper.png)

Newspaper focuses on readability and content density with neutral surfaces and strong text contrast.

## Highlights

- Editorial look for text-heavy applications
- Clear hierarchy for headlines and body content
- Light and dark variants for long reading sessions
